name: CVEL: Lunar Rover, Gale Crater
description: The CVEL Lunar Rover on Mars at Gale Crater base, where the ground is a scanned model of the crater and its central mound (import/nasa/Gale Crater.stl) set into the terrain. Shift and Ctrl raise and lower the throttle, which goes below zero to reverse (X sets zero), A/D steer, B brakes.
